FACULTY OF ENGINEERING
B.E. (BL) Degree Examination
Code No. : E-5616/N/BL
Subject : BS 204 CH — Engineering Chemistry
Time: 3 hours                         Max. Marks: 70

Note: First question is compulsory.

1. a) Define electrochemical cell and electrode potential.
   b) State Nernst equation and its applications.
   c) Explain reference electrodes with examples.
2. a) Explain EDTA method for hardness of water.
   b) Discuss ion exchange process for softening of water.
3. a) Explain conducting polymers with polyacetylene example.
   b) Write differences between thermoplastic and thermoset polymers.
4. a) Explain proximate and ultimate analysis of coal.
   b) Define octane and cetane numbers.
5. a) Explain principles of green chemistry.
   b) Describe transesterification process for biodiesel.
6. a) Explain composite materials and their classification.
   b) Write applications of composites in engineering.
7. a) Explain fuel cells and their working.
   b) Compare primary and secondary batteries.
